utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — Saturday morning would be best if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday morning works for me — I’ll be there, and I’ll ask around for a couple more handy neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Vik — thank you! I’ll put you down for Saturday on the front porch and let the others know we’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll be on the front porch this Saturday and lend a hand for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess — I’ll bring the hammer and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Mina — that’ll be a huge help on Saturday. I’ll make sure we’ve got a spot for you on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — I’ll bring the hammer and I’ll look for work gloves too. I’ll make sure everyone knows to meet at 10 a.m. on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect — 10 a.m. on the front porch works for me. Thanks, Pia, and I’ll be there for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’m still aiming to be there Saturday for the repair drive. Just remind me what time you want me out front, and I’ll do my best to show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll be out front Saturday morning for the repair drive, so just come by then and I’ll lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — I’ll bring the hammer and see if I can find some work gloves too. I’ll make sure everyone still knows it’s 10 a.m. on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Pia — thank you! I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure Oren knows you’re coming.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, I’ll bring the hammer and work gloves and be there at 10 on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mina — thank you. I’ve got you down for 10 on the front porch, and Vik will be there too, so we’re set.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
